items.mainDefect: The blacklist check compares lowercased blacklist entries against non-normalized guest emails, so mixed-case emails get past the blocklist.

secondary.defect: The attendee-duplicate check (`guest === attendee.email`) is case-sensitive, so the same email in a different case is not caught as a duplicate.

items.mainDefect: The duplicate-guest check is a non-atomic check-then-write with no DB uniqueness guarantee, so concurrent addGuests calls can insert duplicate attendee rows.

secondary.defect: The incoming guests array is not deduplicated on the server, so a single request that repeats an email creates duplicate attendee rows.
